objects.name: Analytic 2250
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) requests to an embedded Human-Machine Interface (HMI) panel's built-in web server capturing screen images, or Virtual Network Computing (VNC) connections to embedded HMI panels, from source Internet Protocol (IP) addresses not in the approved operator workstation list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
